description: Search 16,000+ World Bank development indicators by keyword or topic — GDP, population, poverty, education, health, environment, trade. Returns indicator ID, name, source, description, topics. Use indicator IDs with finance.country_data for time-series data (World Bank, CC BY 4.0)
